svg.title: How I ship: code, commit, CI/CD, package, orchestrate, expose, observe
svg.desc: Java and Go code is committed to GitHub, built, tested and scanned by Jenkins and GitHub Actions with SonarQube, packaged as Docker images tagged by SHA, deployed as microservices on Kubernetes with Helm and Kustomize, exposed through the Gateway API, Cloudflare Tunnel and AWS, and observed with Prometheus and Grafana. A failed smoke test rolls back automatically.

g.text: one change, from my editor to production, on every project
alerts and dashboards feed the next change
